filters.q: PLACEHOLDER_TO_VALIDATE: e.g. from:noreply@fresha.com subject:(booking OR confirmed)

nodes.name: New Fresha Booking Email
nodes.notes: TO_VALIDATE: filter query and poll interval. Needs a real sample Fresha booking-confirmation email to confirm sender address and subject pattern before this is reliable.

nodes.name: Parse Booking Details
nodes.notes: TO_VALIDATE: this regex/extraction logic is a placeholder guess at Fresha's email format (client name, service, date/time, booking reference). Must be rebuilt against a real sample email before this node can be trusted.

nodes.name: Log New Booking
nodes.notes: Append row: Booking Reference, Client Name, Service, Appointment Date/Time, Status=New, Instructions Sent At, Reminder Sent At, Verified At, Verified By, Confirmation Sent At, Notes.

string.name: depositMessageDraft
string.value: =Hi {{$json["clientName"]}}! Thanks for booking {{$json["service"]}} with Mehua Lashes on {{$json["appointmentAt"]}}. To confirm your slot, please send your deposit of [AMOUNT_TO_VALIDATE] via Juice/bank transfer to [DETAILS_TO_VALIDATE], and reply here with a screenshot. Booking ref: {{$json["bookingRef"]}}

nodes.name: Draft Deposit Instructions
nodes.notes: TO_VALIDATE: deposit amount and payment details are placeholders. Message text is a draft the owner sends manually via WhatsApp - n8n does not send WhatsApp directly on the free Business App tier.

nodes.name: Notify Owner - Deposit Instructions
nodes.notes: Sends the drafted WhatsApp text to the owner's own inbox so she can copy-paste and send it herself. Replace with WhatsApp/Telegram notification if the owner prefers, once decided.

parameters.subject: =Booking email could not be parsed - please check
parameters.message: =A Fresha booking email arrived but could not be automatically parsed. Please check it manually and log the booking. Raw subject: {{$json["subject"]}}

nodes.name: Notify Owner - Unparseable Booking Email
nodes.notes: Error handling: never fail silently. Flags the row for manual follow-up instead.

nodes.name: Filter Rows Overdue (>48h, not verified)
nodes.notes: TO_VALIDATE: 48h escalation window is from the source research, not yet confirmed with the owner. Filters rows where Status is Instructions Sent/Reminder Sent and hours since Instructions Sent At exceeds the window.

parameters.subject: =Reminder needed - deposit still pending for {{$json["clientName"]}}
parameters.message: =No deposit confirmation logged yet for booking {{$json["bookingRef"]}}. Suggested reminder to send: Hi {{$json["clientName"]}}, just a friendly reminder to send your deposit to confirm your {{$json["service"]}} appointment on {{$json["appointmentAt"]}}.

parameters.formDescription: Owner-only: use after checking the bank/Juice statement yourself. Never mark verified without checking.

nodes.name: Owner Form - Mark Deposit Verified
nodes.notes: Human-in-the-loop checkpoint. The owner is the only one who submits this, only after checking the bank/Juice statement herself. This is intentionally the single point where automatic 'verified' status is impossible.

string.name: confirmationMessageDraft
string.value: =Hi {{$json["clientName"]}}, your deposit is confirmed! Your {{$json["service"]}} appointment is booked for {{$json["appointmentAt"]}}. [POLICY_TEXT_TO_VALIDATE] [LOCATION_TEXT_TO_VALIDATE] See you soon!

nodes.name: Draft Final Confirmation
nodes.notes: TO_VALIDATE: exact policy and location wording not yet supplied.

meta.note: Prototype scaffold, not yet validated against a live n8n instance or real Fresha email. See workflows/README.md and docs/mehua-deposit-concierge-spec.md before relying on this. Every node marked TO_VALIDATE needs real input from Joshua/Mehua before this is trustworthy.
